title: FlowTSFM: Turning Encoder Depth into Quantile Transport
abstract: arXiv:2609.13640v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Encoder-based time series foundation models (TSFMs) typically rely on deep stacks of independently parameterized Transformer layers, where only the final forecast is supervised and intermediate representations have no explicit predictive role. We introduce FlowTSFM, an encoder architecture that interprets depth as a recurrent transport process: a single Transformer block is iteratively applied with shared parameters, while a quantile-flow objective supervises intermediate states along a prescribed trajectory from a prior distribution toward the final forecast. The objective combines pinball forecasting loss with path-level position matching. With only 38.8M parameters, FlowTSFM achieves competitive performance on GIFT-Eval and TIME, remaining within 1.8-4.6% MASE of stronger baselines while using approximately $3\times$ fewer parameters than a 12-layer Chronos-2 model (119.5M). translated_title: FlowTSFM：将编码器深度转化为分位数传输
translated_abstract: 基于编码器的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）通常依赖于独立参数化的深层Transformer层堆栈，其中只有最终的预测结果受到监督，中间表示没有明确的预测作用。我们提出FlowTSFM，这是一种将深度解释为循环传输过程的编码器架构：一个单一的Transformer块以共享参数被迭代应用，同时通过分位数流目标对从先验分布到最终预测的既定轨迹上的中间状态进行监督。该目标函数结合了弹球（pinball）预测损失与路径级位置匹配。FlowTSFM仅有3880万参数，在GIFT-Eval和TIME基准测试中取得了具有竞争力的性能，与更强的基线相比MASE差距保持在1.8-4.6%以内，同时所使用的参数比12层的Chronos-2模型（1.195亿参数）少约3倍。除准确性之外，我们还引入了CosMean，一种无尺度的诊断（方法）……
tldr: FlowTSFM将编码器深度重新诠释为共享参数的循环分位数传输过程，仅用3880万参数就达到了与更大模型相当的时序预测性能。
en_tdlr: FlowTSFM reinterprets encoder depth as a recurrent quantile transport process with shared parameters, achieving competitive time series forecasting performance with only 38.8M parameters.
